entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. I need to return an Aero Race Jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference. I think I ordered the wrong size. I've worn it once briefly around the house and it's just far too tight for me to be comfortable on a ride.
I understand completely. That particular jersey has a very aggressive 'race fit'. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 72 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Alright, I've checked and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process this for you. Would you like to do an exchange for a different size, or would you prefer a refund?

That's great news. I think I'll just take the refund for now. Since I have to go through the trouble of shipping it back, and the sizing was a bit off from what I expected, could you perhaps offer a small discount on a future order?

I'm happy we can process the return for a full refund for you. While I can't add a discount code for a sizing preference issue, I've gone ahead and authorized the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the item up and drop it off.
Okay, that's fair. The refund is the most important part. I appreciate your help with this.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day!
